p: A customer support team of three, one woman and two men in navy business suits with simple headsets, standing together beside a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, with a blank laptop and a blank tablet.
A tired customer support woman in a navy business suit with a headset at a desk, searching through tall stacks of blank folders and many blank documents with a magnifying glass, looking exhausted.

A customer support man in a navy business suit with a headset at a desk answering together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, who holds up a blank tidy reply sheet, a blank laptop on the desk.

A busy customer support woman in a navy business suit at a desk, overwhelmed while checking blank forms against a blank monitor, moving blank sheets from one tray to another, with piles of blank paper around her.

A customer at home in casual clothes holding a smartphone, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face points to one blank web page with plain bars, a neat shelf of blank public leaflets beside them.

A friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face asking a customer in casual clothes simple questions, and passing a neat blank card and a paperclip attachment across to a support woman in a navy business suit at a desk.

A customer in casual clothes speaking on a phone, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face listening with simple sound waves, directing a line that branches to three support staff in navy suits with headsets, one highlighted in amber.

A support man in a navy business suit with a headset at a desk reviewing one blank draft reply, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face brings a blank open binder and a small blank reference note from a shelf of blank binders.

A long ribbon of blank chat bubbles and blank mail envelopes flowing into one short tidy blank summary sheet held by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, which a support woman in a navy suit receives from a colleague man in a navy suit.

A customer in casual clothes on a phone looking relieved, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holding a simple shield with a check mark, beside a blank tracking line with three plain dots and a small delivery truck.

A traveler woman in casual clothes with a small suitcase looking at a tablet, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face showing a blank calendar without characters and a neat checklist of plain icons like a bag and a ticket without characters.

A person in casual clothes receiving a blank envelope notification on a smartphone next to a small house icon, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holding a simple shield with a check mark, a support man in a navy suit waiting nearby with a headset.

A support woman in a navy business suit at a desk making a decision with one blank folder, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face lines up a blank receipt, a photo of a damaged cardboard box and a blank sheet, with one gap highlighted in amber.

A friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face sorting plain empty chat bubbles into three neat piles, handing one blank card to a support man in a navy suit who updates a blank open guide book.
